title: Plan Change
description: An in-app billing screen: choose a plan and billing cycle with native choice cards, set seats and review a prorated summary.
summary: Choice-card plan picker with a sticky order summary.
notes: Plan and cycle are real radio groups and the seat count is a real number input, but the summary does not recalculate: totals, proration, tax and the saved card must come from your billing provider.
Prices match the Three-tier Pricing block and are sample figures. The form has no action; submitting it only reloads the page.
The summary card becomes sticky beside the options from 56rem.
